description: Scroll the page, a container, or an element into view. Reports the position and content growth (scrollHeight delta — detects lazy-loaded content) and handles settle timing. Use container_ref/container_selector plus direction to scroll inside a container.

amount.description: Pixels per scroll (default 500); only with direction

container_ref.description: Scrollable container ref (scrolls it, not the page)

direction.description: up or down (default down); used when no ref/selector

ref.description: Element ref to scroll into view

selector.description: CSS selector to scroll into view

name: scroll
